description: Fork of exp646 (tiny SOTA = 1.4939 @ 48.76M, bs=16). Two coupled changes: D (residual_dim) 384 -> 192 AND residual_tph 64 -> 128. unembedder Linear(D, V) halves: 12.58M -> 6.29M (-6.29M). residual_lut weights stay constant per layer (n_out halves but tph doubles: 1*128*64*192 = 1*64*64*384 = 1,572,864). residual_lut anchor coverage doubles (better for E=96, since tph doubled). Expected total params ~42.47M (significantly smaller). Tests how much accuracy we lose halving D + doubling residual_lut tph. Reference: exp646 = 1.4939, exp645 = 1.5025, vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
